daily_summary: Nike Q4 earnings beat estimates, but tariff refund boosted results. - Nike warns of continued streetwear weakness and cautious revenue outlook. - Nike CEO admits brand is not living up to full potential. - Nike Q4 results and sales guidance indicate a choppy recovery. - Nike swings to Q4 profit, but China slump deepens. - Nike's turnaround remains a work in progress, projecting revenue declines. - Nike shares fall after warning of another quarter of revenue declines. - Nike's turnaround strategy faces challenges with flat sales. - Nike's weakness is an internal problem, not a consumer problem. - Nike closes stores, studios, and its flagship location.
